realClasses: inbox, message, developer-message, system-message, assistant, tool, turn-error, turn-max-tokens, turn-tail Definitions, unknown-surface fallback and the chat snapshot builder (ui-chat)
glue: fake SessionRemotes: session.follow yields the fixture frames per connection generation, session.page answers recorded pages matched on (address, throughSeq, beforeSeq), $stream builds the real RemoteStream over a fake connection handle
step driver, settle loop and snapshot encoder

conversation feed loop (copy of BoundConversation) and the chat projection (tool/vectors/ts/chat_glue.mjs); turn-process, request-prompt, command, compaction, model-retry and process groups are not registered
